scopeReview: CED FUN-7.B.1–2: verify proposed functions by differentiation/substitution on the claimed domain and check initial data independently. First and second derivatives use previously learned rules; no solution method beyond direct verification is required. The demonstrated parameter family shows that infinitely many solutions may occur, without asserting this for every equation. No Euler method or logistic modeling is assessed.
varietyReview: Exponential sign/factor, root branches with a discriminating initial condition, inhomogeneous residual, second-derivative frequency, composite-chain verification argument, negative reciprocal with positive square rate, sine constant shift and initial value, a genuine all-real-parameter family, a failed isolated-point test, constant equilibrium without division and real-log domain. Seven original-function differential-residual checks and four exact conceptual reviews.
repetitionReview: Each prompt and all four options were read separately; distinct tasks/contexts within this set. Cross-topic exact duplicates checked by validator. Semantic similarity and AP difficulty remain judgment calls, not proven by an automated score.
